requirement: S3B §14: backbone, temperature, retrieval budget, max steps and audit rules held identical across arms

identical_across_arms.temperature: not set per-arm; inherited from the same config for all arms
identical_across_arms.max_steps: not set per-arm; inherited from the same config for all arms

note: M1 and M2 differ only in which store they read; the retrieval budget (k, min_score) is the same constant for both, so a difference between them is attributable to admission, not to how much either was allowed to retrieve. §14 also notes memory changes the prompt, so no arm may be scored from another arm's replay.
